list.title: Orders
list.description: Track every purchase order from draft to delivery.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by order code or supplier
list.noOrdersDescription: Import a purchase order from a spreadsheet to get started.
list.noResultsDescription: Try a different search or clear the filters.

detail.liveHint: This page updates automatically when someone changes the order.

progress.label: Order progress
progress.offPath: This order left the normal flow: {status}.

detail.discardBody: The draft is deleted for good. This cannot be undone.

attention.SupplierConfirmed: The supplier confirmed quantities. Distribute them across locations to continue.
attention.ReadyForRedistribution: A postponed order was accepted. Distribute the quantities across locations to continue.
attention.ProductionPostponed: This is a child order with the units production could not deliver. Accept or reject it.
attention.ErpSubmissionFailed: The ERP rejected this order. Review the documents, fix the product codes if needed and retry.
attention.RedistributionConfirmed: The distribution is confirmed. Send the order to the ERP.
attention.LogisticsPending: The ERP accepted the order but logistics is still pending.

detail.viewParent: This is a child order · view the parent order

Submit.title: Submit this order?
Submit.body: The supplier will be able to review it. You won't be able to edit the quantities afterwards.

ConfirmProduction.title: Confirm production?
ConfirmProduction.body: The quantities you entered become the production commitment.

CancelBySupplier.title: Cancel this order?
CancelBySupplier.body: The buyer is notified and the order is closed. This cannot be undone.

AcceptPostponed.title: Accept this postponed order?
AcceptPostponed.body: It will move on to redistribution.

Reject.title: Reject this order?
Reject.body: The order is closed. This cannot be undone.

Cancel.title: Cancel this order?
Cancel.body: The order is closed. This cannot be undone.

MarkDispatchAndInvoice.title: Mark as dispatched and invoiced?
MarkDispatchAndInvoice.body: Confirms the goods left and were invoiced.

Complete.title: Complete this order?
Complete.body: The order is closed as delivered.

lines.title: Order lines
lines.editableHint: Enter the quantities you can deliver. Press Enter or leave the field to save.

difference.title: Confirm order
difference.intro: Production confirmed fewer units than requested for some products:
difference.chooseLabel: What happens with the missing units?
difference.acknowledgeHint: They will not be delivered on this order.
difference.split: Deliver them later in child orders
difference.splitHint: Each child order is a new order with its own delivery date.
difference.remaining: {count, plural, =0 {Fully assigned} other {# left to assign}}
difference.createdChildren: Order confirmed. Created {count, plural, one {child order {codes}} other {# child orders: {codes}}}.

redistribution.title: Redistribution
redistribution.intro: Distribute the confirmed units of each product across locations. Each row must add up to the confirmed quantity.
redistribution.readOnlyIntro: The distribution of confirmed units across locations.
redistribution.empty: There is no distribution to show yet.
redistribution.useProposalHint: Scales the original distribution to what was confirmed.
redistribution.proposalLoaded: Proposal loaded. Review it and save or confirm.
redistribution.confirmBody: The distribution becomes final and the order can be sent to the ERP.

erp.title: ERP integration
erp.intro: Documents created in the ERP for this order.
erp.sendTitle: Send this order to the ERP?
erp.sendBody: Purchase orders and transfer requests are created in the ERP. It is safe to retry: documents already sent are not duplicated.
erp.requested: Submission requested. This page updates when the ERP answers.
erp.notAvailable: ERP documents are not available for your role.
erp.fixCodesIntro: If the ERP rejected a product code, replace it with the right one and retry.
erp.codeCorrected: Product code corrected. You can retry the submission.

import.title: Import an order
import.description: Upload the order spreadsheet. We check it first, so nothing is created until it is valid.
import.dropHint: or click to choose a .xlsx file (up to 10 MB)
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB.
import.checkErp: Also check the products against the ERP
import.checkErpHint: Verifies that each product exists, is active and has the right pack and price.
import.validWithWarnings: The file can be imported, with warnings
import.counts: {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}} · {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}
import.fixAndRetry: Fix the file and check it again.
import.duplicate: An order with this code already exists.
import.uploadFailed: The file could not be processed.
